name: jev-guardrail
description:
Screens request or response body content using TypeSafe AI's Jev System One model.
Sends a configurable battery of typed questions (calibrated yes/no, or a position on an operator-defined scale) about the extracted text and blocks the request or response when any question's answer crosses its threshold.
The default battery covers jailbreak, harmful-request, and self-harm detection plus an overall severity score; the battery is fully user-configurable to cover additional hazards.
Supports JSONPath extraction to screen specific fields within JSON payloads, and separate configuration for request and response phases.
